x-m-el-econ-08.title: Iibka lagu muujiyey cabbirka sawirka: Imisa jeer ayuu ka weyn u muuqdaa?
x-m-el-econ-08.goal: Marka iibka lagu muujiyo cabbirka sawir laba-jibbaaran, xaqiiji in saamiga cabbirrada indhuhu arkaan uu ka duwan karo saamiga dhabta ah, oo adigu dooro cabbirro ka yar qalloociyaan.
x-m-el-econ-08.material: Iibka bishii hore ee bakhaarrada A iyo B waxay ahaayeen 100 A iyo 200 B. Boosterka xayaysiinta B wuxuu iibka ku muujiyaa cabbirka sawir laba-jibbaaran, wuxuuna yiraahdaa maadaama iibku yahay 2 jeer in ka badan, dhinaca sawirka waxaa la sawiray 2 jeer dherer. Sawirka A wuxuu leeyahay dhinac 2 cm, sawirka B na wuxuu leeyahay dhinac 4 cm. Hoose waxaa ah fasiraadda arday ee boosterkan.

x-m-el-econ-08.thinking.2: Xukunka dareenka uu hab muujin siiyo

x-m-el-econ-08.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi waxa saf kasta sheegayo adigoo si toos ah u xisaabinaya sawir kasta.
x-m-el-econ-08.s.s1.hint.1: Dhig waxa laga yiri dhererka dhinaca agtiisa qiimaha laga xisaabiyey bedka, oo barbar dhig haddii ay isku mid yihiin.

x-m-el-econ-08.s.s1.line.3: Saamiga bedka waa 16 ÷ 4 = 4, sidaas darteed indhaha B wuxuu u muuqdaa 4 jeer ka weyn A.
x-m-el-econ-08.s.s1.explain: Safka 2 waa khalad. Laba-jibbaaran, ballaadhka iyo sarraynta labaduba waxay noqdaan 2 jeer dherer, sidaas darteed bedku wuxuu noqdaa 2 × 2 = 4 jeer ka weyn. Saamiga dhabta ah ee iibku waa 2 jeer, laakiin indhaha sawirku wuxuu u muuqdaa 4 jeer ka weyn.
x-m-el-econ-08.s.s2.prompt: Saamiga dhabta ah ee iibku waa B ÷ A = 2 jeer. x-m-el-econ-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Saamiga bedku waa ka yar yahay 1.8 jeer. Sawirka B aad buu u yar yahay.
